answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake that is slashed when random peer audits catch duplicate or dishonest work, and cap how many identities one stake pool can back. A sybil operator must fund every fake separately and risks losing all bonds at once, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand stakes. Trust is not inherited from an old relic of past reputation: newcomers earn little until audits clear them. One falcon cannot patrol a whole river valley at once, and neither can one operator cheaply run a flock of fakes.
